name: figures
description: The arithmetic every widget shares, as a library the widget plugins require (ADR 0021): the time buckets of a windowed series, the slots of the pre-computed periods, the allowed and the blocked half of summable figures, the keys of the interface matrix's outside ends, the IANA special-purpose address registries, and the installation's members as a response names them, read once per request through the widget's own statements over the installation plugin's views. It draws nothing and reads only through the host it is handed; a widget calls host.lib.figures.<area>.<function>.
